def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved version of `equation_v2`."""
    a = parameters[0]  # Intercept (offsetting gate voltage effect when VGS = 0, VDS = 0)
    b = parameters[1]  # Slope for gate voltage (transfer characteristic)
    c = parameters[2]  # Intercept for drain voltage (output characteristic)
    d = parameters[3]  # Slope for drain voltage (output characteristic)
    e = parameters[4]  # Higher order gate voltage term (transfer characteristic)
    f = parameters[5]  # Higher order drain voltage term (output characteristic)
    g = parameters[6]  # Gate-drain interaction term (transfer characteristic)
    h = parameters[7]  # Second-degree quadratic gate-drain interaction term (transfer characteristic)
    i = parameters[8]  # Square of gate-drain interaction term (transfer characteristic)
    j = parameters[9]  # Linear drain voltage term (output characteristic)
    k = parameters[10]  # Quadratic drain voltage term (output characteristic)
    l = parameters[11]  # Cubic drain voltage term (output characteristic)
